feats.name: Alert
feats.description: Alert Origin Feat You gain the following benefits. Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.
feats.automation: Automatically adds your proficiency bonus to initiative. Initiative swapping is a table decision.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.description: Train three artisan tools; receive a 20% nonmagical-item discount and temporary fast-crafting options.
feats.automation: No permanent numeric stat bonus. Use the described actions, training, rerolls, or limited resources manually. Add any campaign-specific numeric effects with Edit effects.

feats.name: Healer
feats.description: Use a healer kit and a patient’s Hit Die plus your proficiency; healing dice showing 1 can be rerolled once.
feats.automation: No permanent numeric stat bonus. Use the described actions, training, rerolls, or limited resources manually. Add any campaign-specific numeric effects with Edit effects.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description: Luck Points equal proficiency return after a Long Rest; spend them for advantage or to hinder an incoming attack.
feats.automation: No permanent numeric stat bonus. Use the described actions, training, rerolls, or limited resources manually. Add any campaign-specific numeric effects with Edit effects.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.description: Magic Initiate Origin Feat You gain the following benefits. Two Cantrips. You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat’s spells (choose when you select this feat). Level 1 Spell. Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat’s cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Spell Change. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different spell list each time.
feats.automation: Choose a spell list and casting ability. Add chosen spells in Spellbook and set their ability; the free daily cast is tracked manually. No permanent numeric stat bonus.

feats.name: Musician
feats.description: Train three instruments; rest performances grant Heroic Inspiration to a number of allies equal to proficiency.
feats.automation: No permanent numeric stat bonus. Use the described actions, training, rerolls, or limited resources manually. Add any campaign-specific numeric effects with Edit effects.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.description: Savage Attacker Origin Feat You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
feats.automation: No permanent stat bonus. Once per turn you can roll weapon damage twice and choose a roll; do this manually in Weapons.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: Skilled Origin Feat You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.
feats.automation: Choose three skills or tools. Selected skill proficiencies apply automatically; tool training is recorded with the feat.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.description: Unarmed damage can use 1d4 plus Strength; reroll damage ones, train improvised weapons, and push on one qualifying hit per turn.
feats.automation: No permanent numeric stat bonus. Use the described actions, training, rerolls, or limited resources manually. Add any campaign-specific numeric effects with Edit effects.

feats.name: Tough
feats.description: Maximum HP gains twice your character level, including two more HP with each level gained.
feats.automation: Automatically adds 2 HP per total character level to maximum HP. Current HP does not automatically heal.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.description: Ability Score Improvement General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+) Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can’t increase an ability score above 20. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.
feats.automation: Choose two +1 increases (the same ability twice gives +2), capped at 20. All dependent modifiers update automatically.

feats.name: Actor
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+, Charisma 13+.

Disguised impersonation gains advantage with Deception or Performance. You can imitate voices and other creature sounds; listeners test Insight against your Charisma-based DC.

Ability increase: +1 Charisma, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+.

Climb at your normal speed. Standing from prone costs only 5 feet, and a running jump needs just 5 feet of approach.

Ability increase: +1 Strength or Dexterity, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic. The feat traits summary shows Climb speed equal to your effective Speed. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Charger
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+.

Dash gains 10 feet for that action. Once on your turn, a qualifying 10-foot straight approach before an Attack-action melee hit permits either 1d8 extra damage or a 10-foot push against a suitably sized target.

Ability increase: +1 Strength or Dexterity, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

Ability increase: +1 Constitution or Wisdom, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

Prerequisites: Level 4+, Dexterity 13+.

Crossbows bypass Loading and can be loaded without a spare hand. Nearby enemies do not penalize crossbow attacks. A qualifying Light crossbow extra attack can include its ability-based damage bonus once.

Ability increase: +1 Dexterity, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

A bludgeoning hit can shift a suitably sized enemy 5 feet once per turn. A bludgeoning critical makes attacks against that enemy advantageous until your next turn begins.

When holding a Finesse weapon, react to a melee hit by raising AC against melee attacks by your proficiency bonus until your next turn begins.

An Attack-action Light weapon strike enables a Bonus Action strike using another one-handed Melee weapon. The extra strike normally omits positive ability damage. You can draw or put away two eligible weapons together.

Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells bypass that resistance and damage dice showing 1 can count as 2 for that type. Repeat only with another element.

feats.name: Fey Touched
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+.

Always prepare Misty Step and a selected level-1 Divination or Enchantment spell. Each has one free use per Long Rest, plus ordinary slot casting. Use the ability raised by this feat for these spells.

Ability increase: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom or Charisma, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Grappler
feats.description: Grappler General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+) You gain the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Punch and Grab. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn. Attack Advantage. You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you. Fast Wrestler. You don’t have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.
feats.automation: Choose Strength or Dexterity +1, capped at 20. Grapple advantages and movement exceptions are situational; choose roll mode when applicable.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+, Strength 13+.

Heavy-weapon hits made with the Attack action on your turn can add proficiency to damage. A Melee weapon critical or defeat can trigger a Bonus Action attack with that weapon.

Ability increase: +1 Strength, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic. Proficiency damage is added only for Heavy weapons while Attack action on my turn is checked in Weapons. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Heavily Armored

Gain Heavy armor training. This does not equip armor or choose an AC formula for you.

Prerequisites: Level 4+, Wisdom or Charisma 13+.

After a rest performance, up to six witnessing allies within 30 feet, potentially including you, gain temporary HP equal to your level plus the modifier of the ability raised by this feat.

Medium armor can count up to +3 of Dexterity toward AC instead of +2. This benefit does not remove armor-specific Stealth penalties.

AC automatically uses the higher Dexterity cap when Wearing armor is checked and the medium-armor Maximum +2 mode is selected. Keep base AC calculated without this feat. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

Ability increase: +1 Strength or Dexterity, maximum 20.

While mounted, attacks can gain advantage against smaller unmounted foes near your mount. Your mount can avoid or halve Dexterity-save damage, and you can redirect a hit on it to yourself, subject to the feat conditions.

Ability increase: +1 Strength or Dexterity or Wisdom, maximum 20.
feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Weapon Master
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisites: Level 4+.

Choose a Simple or Martial weapon category you are proficient with and gain access to its mastery property. The chosen weapon type can change after a Long Rest.

feats.automation: The chosen +1 ability increase and dependent stats are automatic.  Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Archery
feats.description: Archery Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature) You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.
feats.automation: Automatically adds +2 to attack rolls with weapons classified as Ranged; does not apply to thrown Melee weapons.

feats.name: Blind Fighting
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature.

Gain blindsight out to 10 feet; resolve sight-dependent circumstances using that sense.
feats.automation: No ability-score increase. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Defense

feats.automation: Automatically adds +1 AC while Wearing armor is checked in Combat.

feats.name: Dueling
feats.description:
2024 rules summary

A Melee weapon held in one hand deals +2 damage while you hold no other weapons. A shield does not by itself disqualify this benefit.
feats.automation: No ability-score increase. Damage updates for the eligible weapon when its Dueling / throwing checkbox is enabled in Edit weapon. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.description: Great Weapon Fighting Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature) When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
feats.automation: No permanent bonus. For eligible two-handed Melee damage rolls, treat each damage die of 1 or 2 as 3 manually.

feats.name: Interception
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature.

While holding a shield or eligible weapon, react when a visible attacker hits someone else within 5 feet. Reduce that damage by 1d10 plus your proficiency bonus.
feats.automation: No ability-score increase. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Protection
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature.

With a shield, react to a visible attacker targeting someone else within 5 feet. That attack and later attacks on the protected ally have disadvantage until your next turn starts, while you remain close.
feats.automation: No ability-score increase. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting

A ranged attack using a weapon with the Thrown property adds +2 damage when it hits. This does not add damage to ordinary melee use.
feats.automation: No ability-score increase. Damage updates for the eligible weapon when its Dueling / throwing checkbox is enabled in Edit weapon. Situational actions, reactions, target conditions, limited uses and damage-die changes are resolved manually as described.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting

feats.automation: No extra permanent bonus. The normal weapon roller already includes your ability modifier; use that damage for the eligible Light extra attack without adding it twice.

feats.name: Unarmed Fighting
feats.description:
2024 rules summary
